notes.title: Carrotour Demo Patch Note September 8th
notes.content: [p]Another patch for Carrotour Demo! We fixed a bug that caused the game to fail to get a level's ID (sorry if you ran into it). Besides that, we also added new animations! Moreover, uncompleted levels and levels with only 1 or 2 stars are now highlighted, so you can see them more easily![/p][p]We hope you like this patch! Also, please don't forget to leave a review, and wishlist Carrotour![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566770/Carrotour_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Carrotour Demo Update on August 25th!
notes.content: [p]We have updated Carrotour Demo again! [/p][p]This time, we added more animations to the items, the enemies and the player! Now the levels should look more lively, and we hope you like it. We will likely add more animations to the game; if you have any suggestion about what animations should be added, or which existing animations should be changed and how, please let us know![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566770/Carrotour_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]Do you enjoy Carrotour Demo? If you do, don't forget to leave a review, and wishlist the full version![/p]

notes.title: Carrotour Demo Patch Note August 7th
notes.content: [p]Hi! We've released another patch for Carrotour Demo. We fixed a small bug (that was luckily not very relevant), changed the name of a level, and included the link to our X (Twitter) account in the game! We will be posting more on X, and if you don't want to miss out on the latest news and funny posts about Carrotour, just follow us on X![/p][p]Now, enjoy the new patch! And please don't forget to leave a review, and wishlist Carrotour![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566770/Carrotour_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Carrotour Demo Patch Note July 17th
notes.content: [p]Hello! We made some small changes to Carrotour Demo. We mainly adjusted the dialogue in level 1-0 to be more concise. Also, you can now see a text telling you what the button does when you hover over one of the five buttons at the bottom right corner. And of course, we also fixed some bugs.[/p][p]Enjoy! By the way, please don't forget to leave a review, and wishlist Carrotour![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566770/Carrotour_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Carrotour Demo Update on June 30th!
notes.content: [p]Hello guys! Sorry we've been quiet for quite some time. We were a little bit busy. Anyways, we have updated Carrotour Demo yet again![/p][p]In this update, we added more [b]animations[/b] and [b]effects[/b], as well as [b]smooth transitions[/b] between different scenes. We also made our own cute little [b]mouse cursor[/b]. The game is a lot more polished now, and it should look way better than before. Besides that, we also adjusted some levels to improve your experience when playing them. You can check out all the changes now![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566770/Carrotour_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]If you enjoy the game, don't forget to leave a review, and wishlist Carrotour![/p][p][/p][p]As for the full version, it is almost completed. We plan to playtest it a little bit more, and market it better. We promise Carrotour will come out in 2025, so stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Carrotour Demo Update on May 9th!
notes.content:
[i]Breaking news![/i] We have added [i]new demo-exclusive levels[/i]! Not only did we extend chapter 2 in the demo, we also created special levels that you can unlock by earning enough stars! Go check them out!
Besides new levels being added, we also fixed some bugs, and we hope you enjoy the now improved Carrotour experience.
As always, if you have something to say about the demo, please don't forget to leave a [b]review[/b]! And, you can also [b]wishlist[/b] the full game, so you will be notified as soon as it's released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566770/Carrotour_Demo/

[i]Full game progress update:[/i]
We have finished making all levels that will be in the full game when it's released. The game is about 87% done, but we do still have something to work on, such as editing the last boss fight, adjusting how levels are unlocked, etc. Also, we need to do some marketing... so if you are reading this, go tell your friends about Carrotour!!!!!!!!! Thank you!

notes.title: Carrotour Demo Patch Note & Demo Exclusive Level Announcement!
notes.content:
Hello guys! We have updated Carrotour Demo again. This time, we fixed some bugs, such as:
[list]
[*]Wrong BGM volume in 1-0
[*]Smart Movement sometimes prevented the player from clicking undo
[*]Sometimes the player sprite incorrectly became transparent
[/list]etc.
We also made some QoL changes, such as:
[list]
[*]The thumbnail of the panel that appears when the player hovers over an item is now more detailed
[*]Some guides are now added to the first few levels
[/list]etc.
We hope you find these changes helpful. And, if you have anything to tell us, please do! We really need some feedback!!!

OK, now, what about demo exclusive level announcement? That's right; we are planning to release some demo exclusive levels on [b]May 9th, 2025[/b]! Right now we are still implementing and testing them, but you can look forward to playing them next week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566770/Carrotour_Demo/

And what about full game release date? Well, we are gonna announce it as soon as possible!!!!!!111!! There are still some minor issues we are fixing, and we are still adding content to the full game. Since we are not 100% sure when we will finish all the tasks, we cannot announce a release date yet. However, it will not take long! So, please look forward to the release of Carrotour, and [b][i]wishlist[/i][/b] it if you haven't! Thanks!!!!!!

notes.title: Carrotour Demo Update is Live!
notes.content:
We have updated Carrotour Demo! You can check it out now! The major changes are:
[list]
[*] More levels!
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Some improvements, such as:
- The last line of a dialogue will now wait for the player to click before fading away.
- The game now shows tips when the player loses a boss fight.
- Boss fight difficulty reduced.
And more.
[/list]
If you run into any issues after the update, please let us know so we can fix it as soon as possible! Also, if you like the game, don't forget to leave a review, and wishlist the full game! Thank you for playing Carrotour.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566770/Carrotour_Demo/
Currently, we are still working on the full game, mostly creating more levels and polishing/optimizing the game. Once we have an estimated release date, we will announce it. In the mean time, we will also continue updating the demo, either polishing it and/or adding more content.

notes.title: Carrotour Demo Update on April 11th!
notes.content:
Hello guys! One week ago, we released Carrotour Demo, and have seen many players try it.
Now, on April 4th, we want to announce that we will update Carrotour Demo on [b]April 11th[/b]! The update will include:
[list]
[*] More levels!
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Some improvements, such as:
- The last line of a dialogue will now wait for the player to click before fading away.
- The game now shows tips when the player loses a boss fight.
- Boss fight difficulty reduced.
[/list]
As always, if you have any feedback about the game, please let us know! It's much appreciated.
After this update, we will keep working on the game, and we hope to release Carrotour soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566770/Carrotour_Demo/
